children: Overview
U.S. lodging REIT's Q3 revenue rose 1.2% yr/yr, slightly missing analyst expectations
Comparable hotel RevPAR grew 8.8%, driven by leisure, group, and business transient demand
Net income fell 56% yr/yr, reflecting lower gain on asset sales
Outlook
Host Hotels raises 2026 comparable hotel RevPAR growth guidance to 6.75% over 2025
Company lifts 2026 comparable hotel Total RevPAR growth forecast to 6.0% over 2025
Host Hotels expects 2026 net income of $978 mln and adjusted EBITDAre of $1.87 bln
Result Drivers
RATE AND OCCUPANCY GAINS - Comparable hotel RevPAR rose 8.8% as average room rates increased 5.7% and occupancy rose 2.1 percentage points
FOOD AND BEVERAGE GROWTH - Higher food and beverage revenues contributed to a 7.3% increase in comparable hotel Total RevPAR
OPERATING MARGIN IMPROVEMENT - Higher room rates offset wage expense increases, lifting GAAP operating profit margin by 140 basis points to 9.0%
